references.name: bridge-station-overview.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected elevated eastern overview: the whole station stretches across the Thames on a five-span steel arch bridge with four broad rounded stone river piers. Long dark solar-panel roof is broken into repeated shallow sawtooth bays with pale edges; open glazed sides have slanting green/gray posts, lower bridge girders and triangular open spandrels. Deck follows the river crossing, not the independent road bridge to the west. The north end is partly obscured by contemporary construction; that construction and nearby offices are not station source geometry.

references.name: south-entrance-2025.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected 2025 south-bank entrance detail: broad rounded dark-metal fascia with recessed lights, glazed upper band, pale round entry columns, closed/recessed ground glazing, pale-clad stair/lift circulation beside the elevated platforms. Permanent station structures are modeled without copied logos, lettering, shop brands, people or unrelated high-rises. Hidden north-return and underbridge inventories are coherent original approximations.

note: Two ordinary photographs plus current viewer PMTiles; no bespoke research or downloaded meshes. Roof bay count, steel sections, hidden entrances and floor levels are photo/map-proportioned medium-fi approximations.
